verses: Alif Laam Meem
Kiya logon ney yeh guman ker rakha hai kay unn kay sirf uss daway per kay hum eman laye hain hum unhen baghair aazmaye huye hi chor den gay?
Unn say aglon ko bhi hum ney khoob jancha. Yaqeenan Allah Taalaa unhen bhi jaan ley ga jo sach kehtay hain aur unhen bhi maloom kerley ga jo jhootay hain
Kiya jo log buraiyan ker rahey hain unhon ney yeh samajh rakha hai kay woh humaray qaboo say bahir ho jayen gay, yeh log kaisi buri tajweezen ker rahey hain
Jissay Allah ki mulaqat ki umeed ho pus Allah ka thehraya hua waqt yaqeenan aaney wala hai, woh sab kuch sunnay wala, sab kuch jannay wala hai
Aur her aik koshish kerney wala apney hi bhalay ki koshish kerta hai. Wesay to Allah Taalaa tamam jahaan walon say bey-niaz hai
Aur jin logon ney yaqeen kiya aur mutabiq sunnat kaam kiye hum unn kay tamam gunahon ko unn say door ker den gay aur unhen unn kay nek aemaal kay behtareen badlay den gay

Hum ney her insan ko apney maa baap kay sath acha salook kerney ki naseehat ki hai haan agar woh yeh koshish keren kay aap meray sath ussay shareek kerlen jiss ka aap ko ilm nahi to unn ka kehna na maniyey, tum sab ka lotna meri hi taraf hai phir mein her uss cheez say jo tum kertay thay tumhen khabar doon ga
Aur jin logon ney eman qabool kiya aur nek kaam kiye unhen mein apney nek bandon mein shumar ker loon ga

Aur baaz log aisay bhi hain jo zabani kehtay hain kay hum eman laye hain lekin jab Allah ki raah mein koi mushkil aan parti hai to logon ki ezza dahi ko Allah Taalaa kay azab ki tarah bana letay hain, haan agar Allah ki madad aajaye to pukar uthtay hain kay hum to tumharay sathi hi hain kiya duniya jahaan kay seenon mein jo kuch hai uss say Allah Taalaa dana nahi hai?
Jo log eman laye Allah unhen bhi zahir kerkay rahey ga aur munafiqon ko bhi zahir kerkay rahey ga
Kafiron ney eman walon say kaha kay tum humari raah ki tabeydaari kero tumharay gunah hum utha len gay, halankay woh unn kay gunahon mein say kuch bhi nahi uthaney walay, yeh to mehaz jhootay hain
Albatta yeh apney bojh dholen gay aur apney bojhon kay sath hi aur bojh bhi. Aur jo kuch iftra perdaziyan ker rahey hain unn sab ki babat unn say baaz purs ki jaye gi
Aur hum ney Nooh (alaihi as-salam) ko unn ki qom ki taraf bheja woh unn mein sarhay no so saal tak rahey, phir to unhen toofan ney dhar pakra aur woh thay bhi zalim
Phir hum ney unhen aur kashti walon ko nijat di aur uss waqiah ko hum ney tamam jahaan kay liye ibrat ka nishan bana diya
Aur Ibrahim (alaihi as-salam) ney bhi apni qom say farmaya kay Allah Taalaa ki ibadat kero aur uss say dartay raho, agar tum mein danaee hai to yehi tumharay liye behtar hai

Tum to Allah Taalaa kay siwa buton ki pooja paat ker rahey ho aur jhooti baaten dil say gharr letay ho. Suno! jin jin tum Allah Taalaa kay siwa pooja paat ker rahey ho woh to tumhari rozi kay malik nahi pus tumhen chahaiye kay tum Allah Taalaa hi say roziyan talab kero aur ussi ki ibadat kero aur ussi ki shukar guzari kero aur ussi ki taraf tum lotaye jao gay
Aur agar tum jhutlao to tum say pehlay ki ummaton ney bhi jhutlaya hai, rasool kay zimmay to sirf saaf tor per phoncha dena hi hai
Kiya unhon ney nahi dekha kay makhlooq ki ibtida kiss tarah Allah ney ki phir Allah uss ka iaada keray ga, yeh to Allah Taalaa per boht hi aasan hai
Keh dijiye! kay zamin mein chal phir ker dekho to sahi kay kiss tarah Allah Taalaa ney ibtida’an pedaeesh ki. Phir Allah Taalaa hi doosri naee pedaeesh keray ga, Allah Taalaa her cheez per qadir hai
Jissay chahaye azab keray jiss per chahaye reham keray, sab ussi ki taraf lotaye jao gay
Tum na to zamin mein Allah Taalaa ko aajiz saktay ho na aasman mein, Allah Taalaa kay siwa tumhara koi wali hai na madadgar
Jo log Allah Taalaa ki aayaton aur uss ki mulaqat ko bhulatay hain woh meri rehmat say na-umeed ho jayen aur unn kay liye dard-naak azab hai

Unn ki qom ka jawab ba-juz uss kay kuch na tha kay kehney lagay kay ussay maar dalo ya ussay jila do. Aakhir Allah ney unhen aag say bacha liya, uss mein eman walay logon kay liye to boht si nishaniyan hain

(hazrat Ibrahim alaihi as-salam ney) kaha kay tum ney jin buton ki parastish Allah kay siwa ki hai unhen tum ney apni aapas ki dunyawi dosti ki bana thehra li hai, tum sab qayamat kay din aik doosray say kufur kerney lago gay aur aik doosray per laanat kerney lago gay. Aur tumhara sab ka thikana dozakh hoga aur tumhara koi madadgar na hoga
Pus hazrat Ibrahim (alaihi as-salam) per hazrat Loot (alaihi as-salam) eman laye aur kehney lagay kay mein apney rab ki taraf hijrat kerney wala hun. Woh bara hi ghalib aur hakeem hai

Aur hum ney unhen (Ibrahim ko) Ishaq o Yaqoob (alaihima as-salam) ata kiye aur hum ney naboowat aur kitab unn ki aulad mein hi ker di aur hum ney duniya mein bhi ussay sawab diya aur aakhirat mein to woh saleh logon mein say hain
Aur hazrat Loot (alaihi as-salam) ka bhi zikar kero jab kay unhon ney apni qom say farmaya kay tum to uss bad-kaari per utar aaye ho jissay tum say pehlay duniya bhar mein say kissi ney nahi kiya

Kiya tum mardon kay pass bad-feli kay liye aatay ho aur raastay band kertay ho aur apni aam majlison mein bey hayaeeyon ka kaam kertay ho? Uss kay jawab mein uss ki qom ney ba-juz uss kay aur kuch nahi kaha kay bus jaa agar sacha hai to humaray pass Allah Taalaa ka azab ley aa
Hazrat Loot (alaihi as-salam) ney dua ki kay perwerdigar! uss mufsid qom per meri madad farma

Aur jab humaray bhejay huye farishtay Ibrahim (alaihi as-salam) kay pass bisharat ley ker phonchay kehney lagay kay uss basti walon ko hum halak kerney walay hain, yaqeenan yahan kay rehney walay gunehgar hain

(hazrat Ibrahim alaihi as-salam ney) kaha uss mein to Loot (alaihi as-salam) hain, farishton ney kaha yahan jo hain hum unhen bakhoobi jantay hain. Loot (alaihi as-salam) ko aur uss kay khandan ko siwaye uss ki biwi kay hum bacha len gay, albatta woh aurat peechay reh janey walon mein say hai

Phir jab humaray qasid Loot (alaihi as-salam) kay pass phonchay to woh unn ki wajah say ghumgeen huye aur dil hi dil mein ranj kerney lagay. Qasidon ney kaha aap na khof khayiey na aazardah hun, hum aap ko maaye aap kay mutalaqqeen kay bacha len gay magar aap ki biwi kay woh azab kay liye baqi reh janey walon mein say hogi
Hum uss basti walon per aasmani azab nazil kerney walay hain uss wajah say kay yeh hukum ho rahey hain
Albatta hum ney uss basti ko sareeh ibrat ki nishani bana diya unn logon kay liye jo aqal rakhtay hain

Aur madiyan ki taraf hum ney unn kay bhai Shoaib (alaihi as-salam) ko bheja unhon ney kaha aey meri qom kay logo! Allah ki ibadat kero qayamat kay din ki tawaqqa rakho aur zamin mein fasad na kertay phiro
Phir bhi unhon ney unhen jhutlaya aakhir unhen zalzalay ney pakar liya aur woh apney gharon mein bethay kay bethay murdah ho ker reh gaye

Aur hum ney aadiyon aur samoodiyon ko bhi ghaarat kiya jin kay baaz makanaat tumharay samney zahir hain aur shetan ney unhen unn ki bad-aemaaliyan aaraasta ker dikhaee thin aur unhen raah say rok diya tha bawajood yeh aankhon walay aur hoshiyaar thay

Aur Qaroon aur Firaun aur Haman ko bhi, unn kay pass hazrat Musa (alaihi as-salam) khulay khulay moajzzay ley ker aaye thay phir bhi unhon ney zamin mein takabbur kiya lekin hum say aagay barhney walay na ho sakay

Phir to her aik ko hum ney uss kay gunah kay wabaal mein giriftar ker liya, unn mein say baaz per hum ney pathron ka meenh barsaya aur unn mein say baaz ko zor daar sakht awaz ney daboch liya aur unn mein say baaz ko hum ney zamin mein dhansa diya aur unn mein say baaz ko hum ney dobo diya, Allah Taalaa aisa nahi kay unn per zulm keray balkay)yeh yehi log apni janon per zulm kertay thay

Jin logon ney Allah Taalaa kay siwa aur kaarsaaz muqarrar ker rakhay hain unn ki misal makri ki si hai kay woh bhi aik ghar bana leti hai, halankay tamam gharon say ziyadah boda ghar makri ka ghar hi hai, kaash! woh jaan letay
Allah Taalaa unn tamam cheezon ko janta hai jinhen woh uss kay siwa pukar rahey hain, woh zabardast aur zee hikmat hai
Hum unn misalon ko logon kay liye biyan farma rahey hain unhen sirf ilm walay hi samajhtay hain
Allah Taalaa ney aasmano aur zamin ko maslehat aur haq kay sath peda kiya hai, eman walon kay liye to uss mein bari bhari daleel hai

Jo kitab aap ki taraf wahee ki gaee hai ussay parhiyey aur namaz qaeem keren, yaqeenan namaz bey hayaee aur buraee say rokti hai, be-shak Allah ka zikar boht bari cheez hai, tum jo kuch ker rahey ho uss say Allah khabardaar hai

Aur ahl kitab kay sath behas o mubahisay na kero magar uss tareeqa per jo umdah ho magar unn kay sath jo unn mein zalim hain aur saaf ailaan ker do kay humara to uss kitab per bhi eman hai aur jo hum per utari gaee hai aur uss per bhi jo tum per utari gaee, humara tumhara mabood aik hi hai. Hum sab ussi kay hukum bardaar hain

Aur hum ney ussi tarah aap ki taraf apni kitab nazil farmaee hai, pus jinhen hum ney kitab di hai woh uss per eman latay hain aur unn (mushrikeen) mein say baaz uss per eman rakhtay hain aur humari aayaton ka inkar sirf kafir hi kertay hain
Uss say pehlay to aap koi kitab parhtay na thay aur na kissi kitab ko apney hath say likhtay thay kay yeh baatil parast log shak o shuba)yeh mein partay
Balkay)yeh yeh (Quran) to roshan aayaten hain jo ahl ilm kay seenon mein mehfooz hain, humari aayaton ka munkir ba-juz zalimon kay aur koi nahi

Unhon ney kaha kay uss per kuch nishaniyan (mojzaat) uss kay rab ki taraf say kiyon nahi utaray gaye. Aap keh dijiye kay nishaniyan to sab Allah Taalaa kay pass hain mein to sirf khullam khulla aagah ker denay wala hun
Kiya unhen yeh kafi nahi? Kay hum ney aap per kitab nazil farma di jo unn per parhi jaa rahi hai, uss mein rehmat (bhi) hai aur naseehat (bhi) hai unn logon kay liye jo eman walay hain

Keh dijiye kay mujh mein aur tum mein Allah Taalaa gawah hona kafi hai woh aasman o zamin ki her cheez ka aalam hai, jo log baatil kay mannay walay aur Allah Taalaa say kufur kerney walay hain woh zabardast nuksan aur ghatay mein hain

Yeh log aap say azab ki jaldi ker rahey hain. Agar meri taraf say muqarrar kiya hua waqt na hota to abhi tak unn kay pass azab chuka hota, yeh yaqeeni baat hai kay achanak unn ki bey khabri mein unn kay pass azab phonchay ga
Yeh azab ki jaldi macha rahey hain aur (tasalli rakhen) jahannum kafiron ko gher lenay wali hai
Uss din unn kay upper talay say azab dhaanp raha hoga aur Allah Taalaa farmaye ga kay abb apney (bad) aemaal ka maza chakho
Aey meray eman walay bando! meri zamin boht kushadah hai so tum meri hi ibadat kero
Her jaandaar maut ka maza chakhney wala hai aur tum sab humari hi taraf lotaye jao gay

Aur log eman laye aur nek kaam kiye unhen hum yaqeenan jannat kay unn bala khano mein jagah den jin kay neechay chashmay beh rahey hain jahan woh hamesha rahen gay, kaam kerney walon ka kiya hi acha ajar hai
Woh jinhon ney sabar kiya, aur apney rab Taalaa per bharosa rakhtay hain
Aur boht say janwar hain jo apni rozi uthaye nahi phirtay, unn sab ko aur tumhen bhi Allah Taalaa hi rozi deta hai, woh bara hi sunnay jannay wala hai
Aur agar aap unn say daryaft keren kay zamin o aasman ka khaliq aur sooraj chand ko kaam mein laganey wala kaun hai? To unn ka jawab yehi hoga kay Allah Taalaa, phir kidhar ultay jaa rahey hain
Allah Taalaa apney bandon mein say jissay chahaye farakh rozi deta hai aur jissay chahaye tang. Yaqeenan Allah Taalaa her cheez ka jannay wala hai

Aur agar aap unn say sawal keren kay aasman say pani utaar ker zamin ko uss ki maut kay baad zindah kiss ney kiya? To yaqeenan unn ka jawab yehi hoga Allah Taalaa ney. Aap keh den kay her tareef Allah hi kay liye sazawaar hai, balkay)yeh unn mein say aksar bey aqal hain
Aur duniya ki yeh zindagani to mehaz khel tamasha hai albatta aakhirat kay ghar ki zindagi hi haqeeqi zindagi hai, kaash! yeh jantay hotay

Pus yeh log jab kashtiyon mein sawar hotay hain to Allah Taalaa hi ko pukartay hain uss kay liye ibadat ko khalis ker kay phir jab woh unhen khushki ki taraf bacha laata hai to ussi waqt shirk kerney lagtay hain
Takay humari di hui nematon say mukartay rahen aur barattay rahen. Abhi abhi pata chal jaye ga

Kiya yeh nahi dekhtay kay hum ney haram ko ba aman bana diya hai halankay unn kay ird-gird say log uchak liye jatay hain, kiya yeh baatil per to yaqeen rakhtay hain aur Allah Taalaa ki nematon per na-shukri kertay hain
Aur uss say bara zalim kaun hoga? Jo Allah Taalaa per jhoot bandhay ya jab haq uss kay pass aajaye woh ussay jhutlaye, kiya aisay kafiron ka thikana jahannum mein na hoga?
Aur jo log humari raah mein mushaqqaten bardasht kertay hain hum unhen apni raahen zaroor dikha den gay. Yaqeenan Allah Taalaa neko kaaron ka sathi hai
